stem: Priya measures the length of her new geometry box using a 30 cm scale. Which method will give her a correct and reliable measurement?

options.text: She places the scale touching the box along its length, reads it with her eye directly above the end mark, and writes the number with the unit.
She holds the scale slightly above the box and reads it from the side, then writes the number with the unit.
She places the scale touching the box but only writes the number, since the unit is obvious.
She places the scale touching the box and reads it while sitting to one side, then writes the number with the unit.

teacher.key_rationale: Reliable length measurement requires the scale in contact along the object, the eye directly above the endpoint (avoiding parallax), and reporting both number and unit. Only A satisfies all three; B introduces parallax and poor contact, C omits the unit, D introduces parallax.
